This research isn't about whether sugar exacerbates cancer but, as the title says, how (and which sugars specifically). One would imagine that cancer would have a harder time growing on the sugar from organic oranges, mangoes and blueberries, than it would from super-processed high fructose corn syrup grown with Roundup and covered in pesticides on a slider of partially hydrogenated poly quaternium 80 rapeseed (aka engine) oil.
